title: Nacionalismo cultural
goal: Read how Mexican muralism and indigenismo celebrated the indigenous past while living indigenous communities remained marginalized, and how similar cultural-nationalist movements arose across the region.
grammar: A pesar de que + subjuntivo: una contradicción reconocida

items: Explain what accompanied state-building beyond administrative matters.
Describe what José Vasconcelos did as Mexico's Minister of Education.
Explain the contradiction at the heart of indigenismo.
Describe what the 1922 Semana de Arte Moderno sought to do in Brazil.
Use a pesar de que + subjunctive to name a recognized contradiction.
